2607.01000.title: KnowledgeDebugger -- an Exploration Tool for Knowledge Localization and Editing in Transformers
2607.01000.paper_summary: Recent research has increasingly focused on understanding how Transformers store and process knowledge, as well as how this knowledge can be edited. Research work in this area is often conducted in two phases: first, phenomena are explored on individual samples. Then, when results appear promising, more statistically robust experiments follow. To support the first phase, we propose KnowledgeDebugger, a GUI-based exploration tool for knowledge localization and editing in Transformers. Our tool - inspired by LM-Debugger - offers no-code access to the methods in EasyEdit, a widely used library of state-of-the-art Knowledge Editing approaches. We demonstrate the tool's effectiveness through case studies of recent findings in this field.
2607.01000.paper_summary_zh: 最近的研究越來越集中於理解Transformer如何儲存和處理知識，以及如何編輯這些知識。這個領域的研究工作通常分為兩個階段：首先，在單個樣本上探索現象。然後，當結果顯示出希望時，會進行更具統計意義的實驗。為了支持第一階段，我們提出了KnowledgeDebugger，一個基於GUI的探索工具，用於Transformer中的知識定位和編輯。我們的工具 - 受到LM-Debugger的啟發 - 提供無需編碼的方式來訪問EasyEdit中的方法，這是一個廣泛使用的最先進知識編輯方法庫。我們通過對該領域近期發現的案例研究來展示該工具的有效性。
